questions.stem: What is the correct name for a molecule formed by two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom?
questions.solution: The molecule formed by two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom is commonly known as water. This is the standard name used in chemistry for H₂O. Hydrogen oxide and hydrogen monoxide are not standard chemical names for this compound, and oxygen hydride refers to a different type of compound altogether.

questions.stem: Which of the following correctly represents the formation of an ionic bond?
questions.solution: An ionic bond forms when atoms transfer electrons, creating oppositely charged ions that attract each other. Sharing electrons leads to a covalent bond, not an ionic one. Gaining or losing electrons alone does not fully describe the process, as both must occur for an ionic bond to form. Therefore, the correct answer is atoms transfer electrons.

hi.solution: एक आयनिक बंध तब बनता है जब परमाणु इलेक्ट्रॉन स्थानांतरित करते हैं, जिससे विपरीत आवेश वाले आयन बनते हैं जो एक दूसरे को आकर्षित करते हैं। इलेक्ट्रॉन के साझा होने से सहसंयोजक बंध बनता है, आयनिक नहीं। इलेक्ट्रॉन के ग्रहण या हानि के अकेले होने से पूर्ण रूप से वर्णन नहीं होता है, क्योंकि आयनिक बंध बनने के लिए दोनों ही होना आवश्यक है। अतः सही उत्तर परमाणु इलेक्ट्रॉन स्थानांतरित करते हैं है।

questions.stem: Which scientist proposed the Law of Conservation of Mass?
questions.solution: Antoine Lavoisier is recognized for establishing the Law of Conservation of Mass through his experiments showing that mass is neither created nor destroyed in chemical reactions. Joseph Proust is known for the Law of Definite Proportions, not the conservation of mass. John Dalton and Niels Bohr are associated with atomic theory, not the conservation of mass.

hi.solution: एंटोनी लावोजियर को अपने प्रयोगों द्वारा द्रव्यमान के संरक्षण के नियम की स्थापना के लिए मान्यता प्राप्त है जो दर्शाते हैं कि रासायनिक अभिक्रियाओं में द्रव्यमान का न तो निर्माण होता है और न ही नष्ट होता है। जोसेफ प्रॉस्ट को निश्चित अनुपात के नियम के लिए जाना जाता है, द्रव्यमान के संरक्षण के लिए नहीं। जॉन डाल्टन और नील्स बोहर परमाणु सिद्धांत के लिए जुड़े हुए हैं, द्रव्यमान के संरक्षण के लिए नहीं।

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct way to name an ionic compound?
questions.solution: The correct way to name an ionic compound is to write the name of the cation first, followed by the name of the anion. Potassium chloride follows this rule, as 'potassium' is the cation and 'chloride' is the anion. The other options reverse the order of the cation and anion, which is incorrect.

questions.stem: What is the term used for the simplest whole number ratio of ions in an ionic compound?
questions.solution: The term for the simplest whole number ratio of ions in an ionic compound is formula unit mass, which represents the ratio of ions in the compound. Molecular mass refers to the mass of a molecule, which is not applicable to ionic compounds. Atomic mass is the mass of a single atom, and molar mass is the mass of one mole of a substance, neither of which describe the ion ratio.

questions.stem: Which of the following ions would combine with a sodium ion to form a neutral compound?
questions.solution: A sodium ion (Na+) has a +1 charge. To form a neutral compound, it needs to combine with an ion that has a -1 charge. Chloride (Cl-) has a -1 charge, making it the correct choice. Oxygen (O2-) has a -2 charge, calcium (Ca2+) has a +2 charge, and iron (Fe3+) has a +3 charge, none of which would form a neutral compound with sodium.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा आयन सोडियम आयन के साथ मिलकर एक उदासीन यौगिक बनाएगा?
hi.solution: सोडियम आयन (Na+) के पास +1 आवेश होता है। एक उदासीन यौगिक बनाने के लिए, इसे -1 आवेश वाले आयन के साथ मिलना चाहिए। क्लोराइड (Cl-) के पास -1 आवेश होता है, जो इसका सही विकल्प बनाता है। ऑक्सीजन (O2-) के पास -2 आवेश होता है, कैल्शियम (Ca2+) के पास +2 आवेश होता है, और आयरन (Fe3+) के पास +3 आवेश होता है, जिनमें से कोई भी सोडियम के साथ उदासीन यौगिक नहीं बनाएगा।
hi.critique: Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and solution, with appropriate terminology used in a Hindi-medium science context.

mr.solution: सोडियम आयन (Na+) चा +1 आवेश असतो. उदासीन यौगिक तयार करण्यासाठी, त्याला -1 आवेश असलेल्या आयनासह जोडले पाहिजे. क्लोराइड (Cl-) चा -1 आवेश असतो, जो योग्य निवड बनतो. ऑक्सीजन (O2-) चा -2 आवेश असतो, कॅल्शियम (Ca2+) चा +2 आवेश असतो आणि लोह (Fe3+) चा +3 आवेश असतो, जे सोडियम आयनासह उदासीन यौगिक तयार करू शकत नाहीत.

questions.stem: Which of the following compounds is most likely to conduct electricity when dissolved in water?
questions.solution: Sodium chloride is an ionic compound, and ionic compounds conduct electricity when dissolved in water because their ions become free to move. Camphor, sugar, and naphthalene are covalent compounds, which do not produce ions in solution and thus do not conduct electricity.

questions.stem: If element A has one electron in its third shell and element B has six electrons in its second shell, what kind of ion would A form?
questions.solution: Element A has one electron in its third shell, which means it has a total of 11 electrons, making it a metal with a tendency to lose that electron to achieve a stable configuration. Losing an electron results in a positively charged ion, known as a cation. Anions are negatively charged, neutral atoms do not gain or lose electrons, and noble gases are already stable with full electron shells.

questions.stem: A student burns 10 g of ethanol in an open beaker, and no residue is left. Does this violate the Law of Conservation of Mass?
choices: Yes, because the reaction is incomplete.
No, because the beaker was open.
questions.solution: The Law of Conservation of Mass states that mass cannot be created or destroyed in a chemical reaction. Even though no residue is left, the mass of the products (gases like CO2 and H2O) equals the mass of the reactants (ethanol and oxygen). The other options incorrectly suggest that mass is lost or that the open beaker affects the conservation of mass.

questions.stem: Which of the following combinations gives the correct number of ions for an ionic compound where the total positive charge is 6+ and the total negative charge is 6–?
questions.solution: Calcium has a +2 charge, and sulfate has a -2 charge. 3 Ca²⁺ gives 6+ and 2 SO₄²⁻ gives 6–, making the charges balance. The other options do not result in a balanced charge, as shown by the charges of the ions involved.

questions.stem: A compound consists of 40% sulfur and 60% oxygen by mass. In a sample containing 20 g of sulfur, how much oxygen is required to satisfy the Law of Constant Proportions?
questions.solution: The Law of Constant Proportions states that elements combine in a fixed ratio. If sulfur is 40% and oxygen is 60%, then 20 g of sulfur requires 30 g of oxygen. The other options do not follow the given ratio.

hi.stem: एक यौगिक में द्रव्यमान के आधार पर 40% सल्फर और 60% ऑक्सीजन होता है। 20 ग्राम सल्फर वाले एक नमूने में, स्थिर अनुपात के नियम के अनुसार कितना ऑक्सीजन आवश्यक है?
hi.solution: स्थिर अनुपात के नियम के अनुसार, तत्व एक निश्चित अनुपात में संयोजित होते हैं। यदि सल्फर 40% और ऑक्सीजन 60% है, तो 20 ग्राम सल्फर के लिए 30 ग्राम ऑक्सीजन की आवश्यकता होती है। अन्य विकल्प दिए गए अनुपात के अनुसार नहीं हैं।
